preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree is not None.
The distance k is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.
The target node value is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.data <= 10000 for node in tree_nodes(root))
preconditions.description: All node data values in the tree are between 1 and 10000 inclusive.
The target value exists as a node in the binary tree.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list.
The returned list is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the returned list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: set(return_value) == {node.data for node in tree_nodes(root) if distance_between_nodes(root, target, node.data) == k}
postconditions.description: The set of values in the returned list exactly matches the set of all node values in the tree that are at distance k from the target node.
The returned list contains no duplicate values.
